test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SUJLAM' is written as 'TTKKBL', and 'CHOKY' is written as 'DGPJZ'. How will 'CURDX' be written in the same code language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

For 'SUJLAM' is coded as 'TTKKBL'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e86f5873f279afa1ae0716adc6511303dd1426686598bbdfc0d01f244b8263a.png] 

For 'CHOKY' is coded as 'DGPJZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0eff552d44ddf857de91b06364f25a26346b40937a3eee38103b2c986603edc6.png] 

Similarly **'CURDX' is coded as 'DTSCY' **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de43a51d4beb8decf2bbcd1e8c050dc080ec1c6953ce39c7ad2a9d2ec9e3f250.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
